full_judgment: 15. I have gone through the complaint petition. It appears that there is no seal of the Court and the signature of the learned Advocate and the learned Magistrate on the second and third pages of the complaint petition. Only the complainant wrote his name on the second and third pages with different ink. Therefore, I am of the view that the second and third pages of the complaint petition were substituted subsequently by replacing the original pages Nos. 2 and 3 of the complaint petition and complainant malafide changed the second and third pages of the complaint petition.
